## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Industrials proving leadership with multiple ABOVE TREND names while large-cap Tech shows mixed weakness; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Industrials also strong: FCX (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +11.33%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +6.43%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -4.89%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft/defensive: JNJ (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +4.33%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION; Communication shows mixed RECOVERY patterns (TTWO, META).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +10.83% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +10.05% | 1M: -0.34%) RECOVERY, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -28.50%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -9.04%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select Tech/service names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +10.83% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: A number of mega-caps (AAPL, GOOGL, META, AMZN showing RECOVERY vs MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND) — watch for trend break rather than assuming broad follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is internally rotating: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND lead while MSFT (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND lag. Sector breadth is net positive on the week but leadership is shifting from mega-cap software to semiconductors.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are a clear lead: JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +2.26%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W performance +3.97% supports rotation into cyclicals. Breadth within Financials is constructive for risk-on positioning.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows defensive positioning and short-term fatigue: JNJ (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +4.33%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -1.94% | 1M: +11.70%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W is slightly negative, implying selectivity rather than broad buying.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials, Industrials and Materials exposure via names showing ABOVE TREND (JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +6.43%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +11.33%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap software and Energy laggards (MSFT (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth until Tech confirms a sustained rebound.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +7.61%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and news catalysts to monitor. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -28.50%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND — downside risk persistent.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth supportive; 20 stocks) and Materials (strong single-stock leadership). BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.65%, 10 stocks) and Healthcare for rotation-sensitive names showing CORRECTION patterns.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming its short-term trend would signal reduced rotation pressure. Monitor AAPL (1W: +2.99% | 1M: -0.33%) RECOVERY holding 1W momentum for tech follow-through and JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND continuing to confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (+55): INTC (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +7.61%) ABOVE TREND — production/news confirmed by price strength. TXN (+75): TXN (sentiment +75) — positive guidance for analog demand supportive of the sector; monitor price for confirmation. CRM (+55): CRM (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -6.56%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline exists but price is diverging, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-75): TSLA (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -4.16%) RECOVERY — strong negative headlines but short-term price is up, a distribution signal to monitor. INTU (-55): INTU (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -28.50%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm material downside. ACN (-50): ACN (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND — analyst downgrade aligned with weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap Tech divergence (MSFT (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND) and mixed news-flow (CRM conflicting headlines) that could delay a broad tech rebound.
